description:
Go to https://ground.news/sabine to get 40% off the Vantage plan and see through sensationalized reporting. Stay fully informed on events around the world with Ground News.

Physics has an elephant in the room and its name is complexity. A few years ago a group of researchers made the first serious attempt to quantify it – called “assembly theory” –  and now the same group says their method solves one of the biggest problems in the search for alien life. Genius or nonsense? Let's take a look.
